name: Third-party / supplier compromise
description: A vendor or service provider that holds or processes bank data, or connects into the bank, is breached.

steps.text: Obtain the supplier's incident details in writing: timeline, data and systems affected, their containment status.
Identify bank data held by the supplier and every connection/credential they have into the bank.
Suspend supplier connectivity and rotate shared credentials/keys until they confirm containment.
Record the incident in the DORA register of ICT third-party arrangements and review the contract's security clauses.
